scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter './examples/vite' build
scripts.build:react:source: cd examples/vite && VITE_ENABLE_FRAMEWORK_SWITCHER=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/react/ vite build
scripts.build:vue:source: cd examples/vue && VITE_ENABLE_FRAMEWORK_SWITCHER=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/vue/ vite build
scripts.build:assemble: rm -rf examples/parity/dist && mkdir -p examples/parity/dist && cp -R examples/vite/dist examples/parity/dist/react && cp -R examples/vue/dist examples/parity/dist/vue
scripts.build:pdf: bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/i18n' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/core' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/pro' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/pptx-to-pdf' build
scripts.build:preview: bun run build:react:source && bun run build:vue:source && bun run build:assemble
scripts.build:nextjs: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter './examples/nextjs' build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/i18n' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/core' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/react' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/vue' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/pro' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/pptx-to-pdf' build && bun run --filter '@pptx-editor.dev/editor-api' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun check -p tsconfig.json && bun run check:lane-boundaries
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-max-lines-caps.mjs && oxlint --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=warn api/ examples/shared/ packages/*/src/ packages/pptx-to-pdf/scripts/ examples/*/src/ scripts/ e2e/
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/check-max-lines-caps.mjs && oxlint --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=warn --fix api/ examples/shared/ packages/*/src/ packages/pptx-to-pdf/scripts/ examples/*/src/ scripts/ e2e/
scripts.test:serial: bun test packages/ooxml-core packages/core packages/pro/src/__tests__ packages/pro/src/drawing packages/pptx-to-pdf packages/editor-api packages/i18n scripts docs && bun run test:dom
scripts.fuzz:collaboration: TEXT_FUZZ_SEEDS=400 FORMAT_FUZZ_SEEDS=400 TABLE_FUZZ_SEEDS=400 TABLE_BODILESS_FUZZ_SEEDS=400 bun test --timeout 120000 packages/pro/src/__tests__/yjs-text-fuzz.test.ts packages/pro/src/__tests__/yjs-table-fuzz.test.ts
scripts.test:dom: bun test --preload ./scripts/test/preload-dom.ts packages/react packages/vue packages/pro/src/react packages/pro/src/vue
scripts.i18n:validate: node scripts/validate-i18n.mjs validate && node scripts/check-i18n-unused.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-missing.mjs
scripts.check:parity: bun run check:parity-contract && bun run check:composable-parity && bun run check:adapter-css-thin && bun run check:adapter-mirror
scripts.release: bun run build:packages && bun run notices:generate && bun run check:package-artifacts && changeset publish
